description: This file contains Python source code implementing functions for inspecting and manipulating ELF files, kernel modules, and shared libraries within a build system. It includes utilities to run strip commands, identify file types, and process dependencies, primarily for package handling and binary analysis in an embedded Linux build environment.

methods.name: runstrip(arg)
methods.description: Strips symbols and sections from binary files based on their ELF type and signature, used to reduce file size and prepare files for deployment.

methods.name: is_kernel_module(path)
methods.description: Detects if a given file is a kernel module by searching for 'vermagic=' string inside the file.

methods.name: is_kernel_module_signed(path)
methods.description: Checks if a kernel module file is signed by reading its tail and searching for a signature string.

methods.name: is_elf(path)
methods.description: Determines the ELF type of a file, including executable, shared library, or kernel module, by invoking the 'file' command.

methods.name: is_static_lib(path)
methods.description: Checks if a file is a static library (.a) by inspecting its magic number.

methods.name: strip_execs(pn, dstdir, strip_cmd, libdir, base_libdir, d, qa_already_stripped=False)
methods.description: Performs in-place stripping of executable and shared library files within a directory, optimizing binaries for size.

methods.name: file_translate(file)
methods.description: Sanitizes file names by replacing special characters with placeholders, used for safe processing.

methods.name: filedeprunner(arg)
methods.description: Analyzes RPM package files to extract their file and dependency information.

methods.name: read_shlib_providers(d)
methods.description: Reads shared library provider information from specific directory listings, used for dependency resolution.

ctags.name: process_deps
ctags.pattern: /^    def process_deps(pipe, pkg, pkgdest, provides, requires):$/

ctags.name: strip_execs
ctags.pattern: /^def strip_execs(pn, dstdir, strip_cmd, libdir, base_libdir, d, qa_already_stripped=False):$/
ctags.signature: (pn, dstdir, strip_cmd, libdir, base_libdir, d, qa_already_stripped=False)
